-- Update all CA house races that were in "Primary" status to "General" where we have both candidates confirmed
UPDATE house_races SET status = 'General' WHERE state_code = 'CA' AND status = 'Primary' AND candidate1_name NOT LIKE 'TBD%' AND candidate2_name NOT LIKE 'TBD%' AND candidate1_name NOT LIKE 'NULL%' AND candidate2_name NOT LIKE 'NULL%' AND candidate1_name IS NOT NULL AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL;
